notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Mulldrifter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Mulldrifter enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mulldrifter trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Mulldrifter.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
